title.zh: CB-BiliAgent
title.en: CB-BiliAgent

sub.zh: 从内容自动化，到创作者工作流。
sub.en: From content automation, to a creator workflow.

intro.zh: 为 B 站音乐二创场景打造的 AI 内容生产工具。从视频获取、歌词识别，到字幕对齐与审校，持续围绕真实创作流程迭代。
intro.en: An AI content-production tool for Bilibili music re-creation — from video sourcing and lyric recognition to subtitle alignment and review, iterated around a real creative workflow.

role.zh: Product Design · AI 应用 · 全流程开发
role.en: Product Design · AI Application · Full-cycle Development

context.zh: 个人项目 / AI 内容生产工具
context.en: Personal project / AI content production tool

kicker.en: It started with a real need

title.zh: 我不想再手动做一遍二创视频。
title.en: I didn’t want to keep making fan videos by hand.

body.zh: 最初的需求其实非常简单：把 Chris Brown 的歌曲做成 B 站二创视频。但实际制作需要反复经历找视频、下载、截取、转写、找歌词、翻译、对字幕、压制、导出。于是我尝试把整个流程自动化——第一阶段的目标不是做出一个完整产品，而是先让流程真正跑起来。
body.en: The original need was simple: turn Chris Brown songs into Bilibili fan videos. But each video meant sourcing, downloading, clipping, transcribing, finding lyrics, translating, aligning subtitles, rendering and exporting — over and over. So I tried to automate the whole pipeline. The goal of stage one wasn’t a finished product; it was getting the flow to actually run.

imageCaption.zh: 桌面 WebUI：从链接到任务处理的完整流水线
imageCaption.en: Desktop WebUI: the full pipeline from link to task

title.zh: 真正的问题，从这里才开始。
title.en: The real problems start here.

body.zh: 第一版能自动完成处理，但拿真实歌曲测试后很快发现：字幕质量根本不够用。Whisper 会把歌词听错、漏掉，尤其是歌曲专有名词、歌手名、连读歌词和现场演唱。
body.en: The first version processed automatically — until I tested it with real songs. Subtitle quality just wasn’t usable. Whisper misheard and dropped lyrics, especially song names, artist names, linked vocals and live takes.

note.zh: Whisper 将歌名识别成错误发音

insight.zh: 这个项目真正的核心，不是「自动生成字幕」，而是「生成可以直接进入创作流程的字幕」。
insight.en: The real core wasn’t “auto-generate subtitles” — it was generating subtitles ready to enter the creative workflow.

title.zh: 从「AI 听到什么」，变成「应该出现什么」。
title.en: From “what AI heard” to “what should appear”.

body.zh: 我没有继续单纯依赖 Whisper，而是引入外部歌词数据 + AI 转写的组合方案：接入 LRCLIB 获取官方歌词，再根据歌曲类型设计两套处理逻辑。
body.en: Instead of relying on Whisper alone, I combined external lyric data with AI transcription: pulled official lyrics via LRCLIB, then designed two processing paths based on song type.

body.zh: 官方歌词 → 准确时间轴 → 直接替换 Whisper 文本
body.en: Official lyrics → accurate timeline → replace Whisper text

body.zh: Whisper 时间戳 + 官方歌词文本 → 模糊匹配 → 重新对齐
body.en: Whisper timestamps + official lyrics → fuzzy match → re-align

prompt.zh: 同时通过 initial_prompt 向 Whisper 提供歌手、歌曲和歌词上下文，减少识别错误。
prompt.en: Also fed singer, song and lyric context into Whisper via initial_prompt to cut recognition errors.

before.zh: 《Under The Influence》原本识别错误的歌词

after.zh: 官方歌词数据纠正，时间轴重新对齐
after.en: Corrected with official lyric data, timeline re-aligned

takeaway.zh: AI 产品的价值不一定来自「模型更强」，也可以来自产品层面对模型能力的重新组织。
takeaway.en: An AI product’s value isn’t always a stronger model — sometimes it’s product-level reorganization of the model’s capabilities.

kicker.zh: 从字幕生成器，到创作工作台
kicker.en: From subtitle generator to a creator workbench

title.zh: 自动生成，并不代表创作者愿意使用。
title.en: Auto-generation doesn’t mean creators want to use it.

body.zh: 字幕准确之后，我又发现新的问题：真正剪视频时，我仍需要不断检查字幕有没有对上、字号是否合适、最终烧录效果如何、某一句是否需要整体移动、多句字幕能不能一起调整。于是开始从「创作者实际操作流程」重新设计工具。
body.en: Once the subtitles were accurate, I hit the next problem: while actually editing I still had to keep checking — alignment, type size, the final burned-in look, moving one line, adjusting many lines together. So I redesigned the tool around how a creator actually works.

d.zh: 预览中的字幕效果与最终压制效果保持一致，支持字号调整。
d.en: Preview matches the final render, with adjustable type size.

d.zh: 参考剪辑软件操作：时间轴缩放、空白区平移、多选字幕、整体平移、滑块导航、表格与视频联动。
d.en: Mirrors editing software: timeline zoom, pan, multi-select, bulk shift, scrubbing, table-video sync.

d.zh: 解决原生视频全屏时字幕层无法同步全屏的问题。
d.en: Fixes the subtitle layer not following native fullscreen video.

summary.zh: 产品不再只是「帮我生成结果」，而是开始介入整个创作过程。
summary.en: The product stopped being “generate the result” and started being part of the creative process itself.

imageCaption.zh: 审校工作台：字幕时间轴与双语字幕编辑
imageCaption.en: Review workbench: subtitle timeline & bilingual editing

kicker.zh: 真实使用，暴露更多问题

title.zh: 看起来没问题，真正使用才知道哪里会崩。
title.en: Looks fine — until you really use it.

body.zh: 这一部分不堆技术日志，只记下真实使用中遇到的四个问题，以及各自如何解决。
body.en: No tech-log dumps here — just four problems that real use surfaced, and how each was solved.

p.zh: 上传文件位于临时目录，文件生命周期结束后路径失效。
p.en: File lives in a temp dir whose path dies after its lifecycle.

s.zh: 将上传文件复制到任务目录，保证后续处理稳定。
s.en: Copy uploads into the task directory for stable processing.

t.zh: 重复下载同一视频导致崩溃

p.zh: Windows 下目标文件已存在时发生异常。
p.en: Exception when the target file already exists on Windows.

p.zh: Gradio 事件参数与组件交互出现错位。
p.en: Gradio event params misaligned with component wiring.

s.zh: 重新检查事件参数和组件调用关系。
s.en: Rechecked event params and component calls.

p.zh: 模板参数处理导致格式化异常。

s.zh: 调整模板和参数处理方式。

loop.zh: 发现问题 → 复现 → 定位 → 修改 → 实际验证
loop.en: Find → reproduce → locate → fix → verify in real use

summary.zh: 产品不是「代码能运行」就结束，而是要验证到真实工作流能够完成。
summary.en: Done isn’t “the code runs” — it’s the real workflow completing.

kicker.zh: 最近一次迭代：从工具到工作流
kicker.en: Latest iteration: from tool to workflow

title.zh: 最后，我开始解决真正影响使用效率的问题。
title.en: Finally, I went after the things that actually slowed me down.

body.zh: 三个真实痛点，分别给出了对应的产品解法。
body.en: Three real pain points, each with a product-level answer.

d.zh: 一场 100+ 分钟的演唱会没必要全部下载。新增按时间段下载 + 画质选择，只获取真正需要剪辑的片段。
d.en: A 100+ minute concert shouldn’t be downloaded whole. Added time-range download and quality selection — grab only the clips you actually edit.

t.en: Processing felt like a black box

d.zh: 处理大型视频时，用户不知道「现在做到哪了」。加入任务管理、实时进度、暂停与删除，让后台过程变得可感知、可控制。
d.en: With large videos you never knew where things stood. Added task management, live progress, pause and delete — the backend became visible and controllable.

t.zh: 现场演唱会无法稳定自动识别

d.zh: Whisper 对现场演唱识别不理想时，不再强迫用户重复尝试。增加歌词搜索 → 手动导入 → 自动翻译 → 中英双语字幕，让 AI 失败之后仍存在一条可用路径。
d.en: When Whisper struggles with live vocals, stop forcing retries. Added lyric search → manual import → auto-translate → bilingual subtitles: a usable path even after AI fails.

imageCaption.zh: 导出发布：压制、元数据与 B 站草稿上传
imageCaption.en: Export & publish: render, metadata and Bilibili draft upload

title.zh: From automation to workflow.
title.en: From automation to workflow.

body.zh: 这个项目没有从一开始就拥有一个确定的最终形态。它是在真实使用中不断暴露问题，再通过一次次迭代逐渐形成的。
body.en: This project never had a fixed final form at the start. It took shape by exposing real problems in use, then evolving through iteration after iteration.

gain.zh: 最大的收获，不是「做出了一个 AI 工具」，而是第一次完整经历了：发现需求 → 产品设计 → AI 能力应用 → 实际开发 → 真实使用 → 问题定位 → 持续迭代。
gain.en: The biggest takeaway isn’t “I built an AI tool” — it’s going through the whole arc for the first time: find a need → product design → applying AI → building → real use → locating problems → continuous iteration.

tech.zh: Python · Gradio · yt-dlp · ffmpeg · Demucs · faster-whisper · DeepSeek
tech.en: Python · Gradio · yt-dlp · ffmpeg · Demucs · faster-whisper · DeepSeek

title.zh: 评论有声：让数据开口说话
title.en: Turning a comment section into readable insight.

sub.zh: 一个面向 B 站评论的舆情分析工具。
sub.en: A sentiment tool for Bilibili comments.

intro.zh: 从一条链接，到一份结构化、能指导决策的用户洞察。
intro.en: From a single link to structured insight you can act on.

role.zh: 产品设计 · AI 应用 · 全流程迭代

context.zh: 个人项目 / AI 内容工具

kicker.en: It started with a real need

title.zh: 一千条评论，没人能一眼看懂风向。
title.en: A thousand comments — and no quick way to read the room.

body.zh: B 站热门视频的评论区动辄上千条，人工一条条翻既慢，又难统一判断标准；而市面上的舆情工具大多针对微博和抖音，B 站的专用工具又少又贵。
body.en: Hot Bilibili videos rack up thousands of comments — slow to read one by one, and hard to judge consistently. Most sentiment tools target Weibo and Douyin; Bilibili-specific ones are rare and pricey.

d.zh: 热门视频评论动辄上千条，人工翻阅成本高。
d.en: Thousands of comments, costly to read manually.

d.zh: 人工判断标准难统一，逻辑散乱，容易漏掉核心观点和争议焦点。
d.en: Hard to standardize; easy to miss the core opinions and debates.

d.zh: 市面舆情工具多针对微博/抖音，B 站专属工具少且贵。
d.en: Most tools target Weibo/Douyin; Bilibili ones are rare and pricey.

title.zh: 从一条链接，到一份结构化报告。
title.en: From a link to a structured report.

body.zh: 我把它拆成一个 AI 能接住的产品流程：给一条 BV 号或链接，自动采集评论和子回复，再从情感、观点、争议焦点多个维度分析，生成一份结构化的 Markdown 报告，最后落到具体的运营判断上。
body.en: I broke it into a flow the AI could hold: paste a BV id or link, auto-collect comments and replies, analyze across sentiment and opinions, emit a structured report, then land on a concrete ops call.

imageCaption.zh: 生成的结构化分析报告

title.zh: 从命令行，到双击即用的桌面应用。
title.en: From a CLI to a double-click desktop app.

body.zh: 功能跑通只是开始，最终它得被运营真的用起来。
body.en: Shipping worked — but the point was for ops to actually use it.

d.zh: 第一版就能跑通全流程，但只能在终端用，门槛高。
d.en: Hit the full flow, but terminal-only and steep.

d.zh: 加了可视化界面、降低门槛，但仍依赖浏览器，体验不连贯。
d.en: Added a visual UI, but still browser-bound and incoherent.

d.zh: 25MB 单文件，无需装 Python，双击即开即用。
d.en: A 25MB single file — no Python, double-click to run.

summary.zh: 每一步都在回答同一个问题：它离“运营真的会用它”还差多远。
summary.en: Every step answered one question: how far is it from “ops would actually use it.”

title.zh: 从 0 到 1，跑通了一条完整的闭环。
title.en: From 0 to 1 — a full loop that works.

body.zh: 打通了 B 站评论采集的全链路，让 AI 多维度情感分析真正落地，最终交付一个可运行的桌面级产品。
body.en: It opened the full Bilibili comment pipeline and got multi-dimensional AI sentiment genuinely running.

kicker.zh: 在实际工作里，它带来什么
kicker.en: What it brings to real work

title.zh: 它不是一个玩具，是一类可复用的能力。
title.en: Not a toy — a reusable capability.

body.zh: 把评论变成能决策的信息，这件事本身可以被很多岗位复用。
body.en: Turning comments into decidable insight is reusable across roles.

d.zh: 分析自己或竞品视频的评论，快速了解用户真实反馈与偏好。
d.en: Read your own or a competitor’s comments to gauge real feedback.

d.zh: 监控大家对某个话题或商品的态度，把握舆情走势。
d.en: Track sentiment on a topic or product to stay ahead.

d.zh: 看清观众关心的争议点和高频观点，直接指导选题方向。
d.en: Surface the debates and top opinions that steer topic choice.

summary.zh: 它把“看评论区”从一件没人愿意做的事，变成一件 1 分钟就能完成的事。
summary.en: It turns reading the comment section from a chore into a minute-long task.

title.zh: 从工具到工作流。
title.en: From a tool to a workflow.

body.zh: 它没有一开始就长成现在这样，而是在真实使用里不断暴露问题、再一次次迭代形成的。
body.en: It didn’t start as this. It was shaped by real problems, iteration by iteration.

gain.zh: 最大的收获不是“做出了一个 AI 工具”，而是第一次完整走过了从发现需求、到产品迭代、再到稳定可用的整个周期。
gain.en: The real win wasn’t an AI tool — it was living the whole arc from need to iteration to something that just works.

tech.zh: Python · Gradio · Bilibili API · LLM · SQL / Excel
tech.en: Python · Gradio · Bilibili API · LLM · SQL / Excel

title.zh: 从一场高门槛赛事，到每周一次的小游戏日。
title.en: From a high-threshold tournament to a weekly mini-game day.

sub.zh: 一次想给游戏破圈的活动，如何变成一套每周都能跑的运营系统。
sub.en: How a campaign meant to break the game out became an ops system that runs every week.

intro.zh: 一款小众冷门的游戏，需要一场活动把热度拉起来。从 0-1 设计团体积分对抗赛，到转向更轻量的小游戏日，我用数据复盘一步步校准方向，最终把它做成每周常态并沉淀出 SOP。
intro.en: A niche title needed a campaign to lift its heat. From a 0-1 team points battle to a lighter mini-game day, I recalibrated the direction step by step with data — finally making it a weekly routine and codifying the SOP.

role.zh: 媒介运营 · 活动策划 · 全链路执行
role.en: Media Ops · Event Lead · Full-loop Execution

context.zh: 工作项目 / KOC 直播活动运营

title.zh: 一款小众游戏，需要一场活动把热度做起来。
title.en: A niche title needed a campaign to build heat.

body.zh: 游戏本身偏小众冷门，自然流量有限，想被更多人看到，就得靠活动破圈、提高热度。参考其他游戏的赛事赛制，我主导策划了一场从 0 到 1 的「团体积分对抗赛」——目标很直接：让更多人知道这款游戏。
body.en: The title was niche and cold, with limited organic reach. To be seen by more people, it needed an event to break out and build heat. Modeling other games' tournament formats, I led a from-scratch "team points battle" — with one direct goal: get more people to know the game.

title.zh: 我把悬念和对抗，设计进了规则里。
title.en: I built suspense and rivalry into the rules.

body.zh: 一场赛事好不好看，除了游戏本身，更取决于赛制怎么搭。我围绕「对抗」「悬念」「参与感」设计规则，让比赛不只看谁强谁赢，而是有故事、有起伏，观众愿意看到最后。
body.en: Whether an event is watchable isn't just the game — it's the format. Around rivalry, suspense and involvement, I shaped rules that gave the match a story and a reason to stay to the end.

d.zh: 给击杀设置赏金，制造对抗与「造梗」，让每局都有记忆点。
d.en: Set bounties on takedowns to manufacture rivalry and meme-worthy moments.

d.zh: 咬紧比分，把悬念留到最后一刻，让观众一直悬着心。
d.en: Keep the scoreline tight and the suspense until the final moment.

d.zh: 加快节奏、轮换阵容，把观众从旁观者变成「精神股东」。
d.en: Faster rotation turns viewers from bystanders into invested spectators.

summary.zh: 一套能留住观众、也容易被记住的赛制。
summary.en: A format that holds viewers and sticks in the memory.

title.zh: 留住核心玩家很容易，破圈很难。
title.en: Easy to keep the core; hard to break out.

body.zh: 复盘下来数据其实还可以，处于常规水平——玩法和奖励都很吸引核心资深玩家，但并没有达到「破圈」这个初始目标。对普通路人和新手来说，吸引力明显不足。
body.en: On review the numbers were actually fine — around a normal level. The format and rewards strongly attracted the core, veteran players, but it didn't reach the original goal of breaking out. For casual viewers and newcomers, the appeal clearly fell short.

d.zh: 上手门槛高，路人还没看懂就流失了。
d.en: Too steep to grasp; casuals drift off before they understand.

d.zh: 偏竞技而非娱乐，非核心玩家没有参与感。
d.en: Skewed to competition, not entertainment — non-core players feel no stake.

d.zh: 缺乏轻松解压的场景，围观价值有限。
d.en: Lacked light, easygoing moments worth tuning in for.

imageCaption.zh: 比赛数据复盘：当场 vs 近期，ACU 与场观对比
imageCaption.en: Data review: event day vs recent baseline — ACU & view comparison

title.zh: 顺着复盘，我把活动做轻了。
title.en: Following the review, I made the event lighter.

body.zh: 结论很清晰：想让人进来，就得把门槛降下来、把娱乐性做上去。于是我转向「小游戏日」——轻量、低门槛、偏娱乐的麦序房活动，让更多腰尾部主播也能轻松参与。
body.en: The conclusion was clear: to draw people in, lower the threshold and raise the fun. So I pivoted to "Mini-game Day" — a light, low-barrier, entertainment-first room event that more mid- and low-tier streamers could join easily.

title.zh: 破圈了，也沉淀下来了。
title.en: It broke out — and it stuck.

body.zh: 官方麦序房模式对腰尾部主播有明显的流量帮扶——几乎每位参与主播的直播数据都翻了一倍。这个轻量模式验证成功后，我把周末小游戏日做成每周固定的常态活动，并沉淀了一套游戏玩法 SOP，用来持续改进体验与效率。
body.en: The official room mode clearly helped mid- and low-tier streamers — nearly every participating streamer's livestream data doubled. Once verified, I made Weekend Mini-game Day a weekly recurring program and codified a gameplay SOP to keep improving the experience and efficiency.

label.zh: 参与主播直播数据翻倍
小游戏日常态化 · 周末固定
沉淀出一套游戏玩法 SOP

title.zh: 从一次破圈尝试，到一套每周都能跑的运营系统。
title.en: From one breakout attempt to an ops system that runs every week.

body.zh: 这场活动的起点 KPI 是破圈，第一次没有完全做到——但它来得很有价值：它让我看清，门槛和娱乐性才是决定一场活动能覆盖多少人、能不能跑成常态的关键。
body.en: The campaign's KPI was breakout; the first pass didn't fully hit it — but the miss was valuable. It showed me that threshold and entertainment value are what decide how many people an event reaches and whether it can run as a routine.

gain.zh: 最大的收获不是「做了一场火爆的活动」，而是学会了用数据诚实复盘：一次活动能不能复利，取决于它是否可复制、能否常态化；以及，能不能同时做到「留住核心」和「触达路人」。
gain.en: The real win wasn't a viral event — it was learning to review honestly with data: whether an event compounds depends on whether it's replicable and can become routine, and whether you can both retain the core and reach the casuals.
